shared_elements: low-relief motifs carved on a standing upright monolith/pillar
curved band or belt-like line crossing the surface
schematic incised/relief linear ornament above the band
justification: Both surfaces are upright monoliths bearing shallow relief in which a long curving band (belt- or arm-like) sweeps across the body with schematic motifs set above it, which is the only real correspondence. Otherwise the content diverges: A depicts a complete anthropomorphic figure with head, face, folded arms, a prominent disc on the torso and repeated bosses and bands, while B depicts a single quadruped animal in strict profile with no human features, disc or repeated ornament visible.
